title: Tanker Truck Driver- Lae
description:
Islands Petroleum
is an independently owned fuel and lubes distributor, and the exclusive distributor for Mobil Lubricants in Papua New Guinea.
Islands Petroleum
operates bulk fuel and lubricant Depots and Distribution Centers in the Islands, Momase, Southern, and the Highlands regions. Our national head office is based in Kokopo.
We are urgently recruiting for
Tanker Truck Driver
for our Lae Depot operations in Morobe Province.
The Role & Responsibilities
Reporting to the Depot Manager, the
Tanker Truck Driver
will be responsible for transporting large quantities of fuel products from the Depot to respective customer sites in a safe and efficient manner.
Other responsibilities include:
Loading, transporting, and unloading of fuels, lubricants in safe and efficient manner.
Complying with all company safety rules, policies, and procedures
Inspect trucks daily and report any mechanical issues in accordance with company vehicle policy.
Perform other related duties as needed or assigned, which may include working at the facility when not delivering.
Role Requirements
Grade 12 Education at least
Minimum of 3 years driving experience as a Tanker Truck Driver or experience in driving similar bigger trucks
Must have an operator Class 4 Driver's License
Experience in a Depot Operations in the downstream petroleum industry would be an advantage.
Show proper driving and navigation skills (Defensive Driving)
Carry out general workplace hazard identification and keep the workplace free from obstructions.
Sound knowledge of road safety regulations and knowledge of local roads and routes
Excellent planning, time management and organizational skills
Excellent customer service, communications, and inter-personal skills
Candidates within the proximity of the location are encouraged to apply.
